detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Today in self-owned infrastructure: I’m a #podcast publisher now. 😅

Almost every day, I find an interesting video or audio file, but don’t have the time to watch or listen to it. 
Now I can drop it into my menu bar and it gets published in a podcast feed.

Perfect way of consuming it later anywhere (or maybe never, but it’s bookmarked and archived).

The software is powered by #ytdlp, #ffmpeg, and #docker, running #selfhosted on my NAS, routed through #nginxproxymanager.
